mod.name: Automated Buildings
mod.description:
Three passive production modules that run without crew. Power and input items go in, finished output comes out. Logistic bots haul I/O automatically.
Modules: - Auto Optronics Fabricator — autonomous version of the vanilla Optronics Fabricator. Produces optronic components and energy cells. - Auto Advanced Assembler — autonomous version of the vanilla Advanced Assembler. Produces tech blocks and energy blocks. - Auto Grow Bed — autonomous grow bed. Consumes water + fertilizer. Player picks one crop per bed (root vegetables, fruits, grains and hops, or nuts and seeds).
All three use the vanilla `<produces>` + `<stateWatchdog autoproduce="true">` pattern. No Java, no AI — just data. Names localized for EN + CN; other languages fall back to EN.
mod.author: mingc
